definitions.explanation: The dorsal side of the hand, opposite to the palm.

examples.japanese: {手|て}の{甲|こう}に{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}る。
examples.english: To apply sunscreen on the back of the hand.

examples.japanese: {手|て}の{甲|こう}で{額|ひたい}の{汗|あせ}を{拭|ふ}く。
examples.english: To wipe the sweat from the forehead with the back of the hand.

examples.japanese: {手|て}の{甲|こう}にシミができた。
examples.english: Age spots appeared on the back of my hand.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {手|て} (hand) + の (possessive) + {甲|こう} (shell, carapace, back). The character {甲|こう} refers to the hard outer surface, as in a turtle's shell.

CONTRAST:
・{手|て}の{甲|こう}: back of the hand (dorsal side)
・{手|て}の{平|ひら}/{掌|てのひら}: palm (palmar side)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{手|て}の{甲|こう}で{拭|ふ}く (to wipe with the back of the hand)
・{手|て}の{甲|こう}にキスをする (to kiss the back of the hand)
・{手|て}の{甲|こう}のシミ (age spots on the back of the hand)
・{手|て}の{甲|こう}に{塗|ぬ}る (to apply to the back of the hand)

USAGE NOTE: {手|て}の{甲|こう} is commonly mentioned in contexts of:
・Skincare and sun protection
・Gestures and body language
・Medical examinations (checking veins, IV placement)

RELATED BODY PARTS:
・{手|て}の{平|ひら}/{掌|てのひら} (palm)
・{足|あし}の{甲|こう} (top of the foot)
・{二|に}の{腕|うで} (upper arm)
・{指|ゆび} (finger)
